skill.name: okx-defi
skill.description: Use OKX onchainos DeFi workflows to discover yield products, review positions, and guide deposit, withdrawal, claim, and chart flows across supported chains. It routes named third-party DApps, swaps, token prices, and wallet balance tasks to the relevant OKX skills.
skill.summary: Discover, review, and manage OKX-aggregated DeFi workflows through onchainos.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown command references, examples, or safety text rather than executable malware indicators. The confirmed risks are a parent-directory reference to a sibling skill file and preflight instructions that can update or install local tooling. No prompt injection attempt or secret collection request was found.

remediation.suggestion: Keep the shared preflight file inside this skill package or use a signed marketplace shared resource. Avoid ../ references to sibling skill checkouts.
Require explicit user confirmation before running installers, preflight updates, or upgrade --force. Show the source and checksum before execution.
Require explicit confirmation before each signing or broadcast step, including chain, wallet address, target contract, value, and action.

content.value_statement: DeFi users need clear steps for finding yield and managing positions across chains. This skill guides OKX discovery, portfolio review, deposits, withdrawals, rewards, and chart checks.
actual_capabilities: Resolves the correct wallet address type for EVM, Solana, XLayer, Sui, Tron, and TON chains.
Lists and searches OKX DeFi products by token, chain, platform, product group, APY, and TVL.
Retrieves product details, accepted tokens, APY history, TVL history, and V3 pool chart data.
Guides deposit, redeem, and reward claim flows with balance checks and ordered transaction steps.
Displays portfolio positions and protocol details with investment IDs, platform IDs, rewards, and V3 token IDs.
Routes named DApps, swaps, prices, wallet balances, and signing tasks to the correct OKX companion skill.
limitations: It depends on the onchainos CLI, OKX services, and supported chains being available.
It does not provide financial advice or guarantee APY, TVL, liquidity, or protocol safety.
It does not handle DEX swaps, token prices, or wallet balances directly.
Transaction signing and broadcasting still require explicit user authorization or a connected wallet workflow.

use_cases.title: Compare Yield Products
use_cases.description: Find DeFi products for a token, compare APY and TVL, and review details before deciding.

use_cases.title: Review Portfolio Positions
use_cases.description: Check DeFi holdings across supported chains and inspect protocol-level details and pending rewards.

use_cases.title: Manage DeFi Actions
use_cases.description: Prepare deposits, withdrawals, V3 liquidity actions, and reward claims with required IDs and checks.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Positions
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my OKX DeFi positions on Ethereum and BSC. Use my connected wallet if available, and show platform IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Find Token Yield
prompt_templates.prompt: Find USDC yield products on Ethereum. Compare APY, TVL, platform, chain, and investment ID before suggesting next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare A Withdrawal
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Aave position on Ethereum, get fresh position detail, and prepare the safest full withdrawal flow.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze V3 Liquidity
prompt_templates.prompt: Find PancakeSwap V3 USDT pools on BSC, review depth and price history, and explain the inputs needed for a deposit.

output_examples.output: A ranked product list with platform, chain, investment ID, APY, TVL, and whether deposits are supported.

output_examples.input: Show my DeFi positions on BSC and Solana.
output_examples.output: A portfolio table with platform name, platform ID, chains, position count, value, and next actions.
A fresh position detail check, reward type selection, required IDs, and ordered signing steps for the claim.

best_practices: Confirm the wallet address and chain before running position, deposit, withdrawal, or claim workflows.
Refresh position detail immediately before withdrawals and reward claims to avoid stale transaction data.
Review APY, TVL, accepted tokens, slippage, and transaction steps before signing anything.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for named third-party DApp requests that should route to DApp discovery.
Do not skip balance checks or position-detail refreshes before generating transaction calldata.
Do not treat APY or TVL output as investment advice or guaranteed returns.

faq.question: Can this skill sign transactions for me?
faq.answer: No. It guides transaction preparation. Signing and broadcasting require explicit user authorization through the selected wallet flow.

faq.question: Can it show my DeFi portfolio?
faq.answer: Yes. It can query supported OKX DeFi position views for provided or resolved wallet addresses.

faq.question: Does it support Aave, Lido, or Uniswap by name?
faq.answer: Named third-party DApp requests should route to the OKX DApp discovery skill, not this skill.

faq.question: Can it compare APY and TVL?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list, search, and inspect products, then show APY, TVL, chain, platform, and IDs.

faq.question: Does it handle wallet token balances?
faq.answer: No. Wallet balance checks are routed to the OKX Agentic Wallet skill.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and data display. Users must assess market, protocol, and transaction risk.
